items.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
items.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

items.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
items.description: The US tech giant says the €13bn data centre project will create tens of thousands of jobs.

items.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
items.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

items.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
items.description: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

items.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
items.description: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

items.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
items.description: It is the latest strike in a long trade war, and comes after Canadian counter-tariffs on US goods come into force.

items.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
items.description: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.

items.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
items.description: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

items.title: Trump gave $45,000 cash gifts to Natalie Harp and two other aides, public records show
items.description: The White House has described the cash gifts to Harp and three others as personal - and legal.

items.title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
items.description: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".

items.title: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
items.description: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.

items.title: Family of killed teen call for death penalty in D4vd trial
items.description: The parents of Celeste Rivas Hernandez say execution "would be perfect" if D4vd is found guilty.
